label: Spiritual Wisdom
intro: Choose the state of awareness that draws your attention now.
selectionNote: This is not a test of whether you have achieved it. Simply choose what speaks to you now.

themes.label: Present awareness
themes.description: Attention rests on what is happening now, rather than on regret about the past or worry about the future.

themes.label: Presence
themes.description: Both mind and body are fully here.

themes.label: Awareness
themes.description: You notice your thoughts, emotions, and bodily sensations.

themes.label: Wakefulness
themes.description: You do not act unconsciously; you know what you are feeling and doing.

themes.label: Mind-body alignment
themes.description: You do not live only in your head; you stay connected with bodily experience as you live.

themes.label: Self-remembering
themes.description: Even while doing something, you remember that you are here.

themes.label: Attentiveness
themes.description: You can notice subtle changes in yourself and your surroundings.

themes.label: A sense of being alive
themes.description: You do not only think about life; you feel through your body that you are alive.

themes.label: Full participation in daily life
themes.description: While eating, walking, or speaking, you are present with what you are doing.

themes.label: Intimacy with the moment
themes.description: You do not escape the present moment; you experience it fully.

themes.label: Inner stillness
themes.description: Even when the world around you is noisy, there is quiet deep within.

themes.label: Silence before thought
themes.description: You sense the quiet that is present before words begin in the mind.

themes.label: Being centered
themes.description: You are not swept away by events around you, and you do not lose yourself.

themes.label: Grounding
themes.description: You do not remain only in thought; you stay connected with your body and reality.

themes.label: Calmness
themes.description: You do not rush to find an answer and can look at things slowly.

themes.label: Inner peace
themes.description: Even when problems exist, there is no inner battle at the deepest level.

themes.label: Clarity of mind
themes.description: Strong assumptions and emotions do not prevent you from seeing things honestly.

themes.label: Allowing empty space
themes.description: You do not feel compelled to fill every quiet or uneventful moment.

themes.label: Receptive silence
themes.description: You do not rush to create an answer; you can feel quietly and wait.

themes.label: Resting in being
themes.description: Even without doing anything, you can feel at ease simply being here.

themes.label: Acceptance as it is
themes.description: Before deciding whether you like or dislike something, you acknowledge the reality that is here.

themes.label: Allowing emotions
themes.description: You do not treat sadness or anger as bad; you allow yourself to feel them.

themes.label: Non-resistance
themes.description: You stop continually denying what is happening and first allow it to be received.

themes.label: Surrender
themes.description: You stop trying to control everything through your own power alone.

themes.label: Trusting the greater flow
themes.description: You trust that life also contains a larger movement you may not yet understand.

themes.label: Freedom from attachment to outcomes
themes.description: You make an effort, but you do not reject yourself when the result is not what you hoped for.

themes.label: Acceptance of uncertainty
themes.description: Even without an answer, you do not immediately become overwhelmed by anxiety.

themes.label: Acceptance of change
themes.description: You accept that nothing remains exactly the same forever.

themes.label: Moving through loss
themes.description: You do not deny the grief of losing something important and allow yourself time to feel it.

themes.label: Trust in life
themes.description: Even without understanding everything, you trust that you can keep moving through life.

themes.label: Surrender to divine will
themes.description: You value not only personal desire, but also a greater good or sacred direction.

themes.label: Moving with the flow
themes.description: You do not force events forward; you act while sensing the right timing and direction.

themes.label: Observer awareness
themes.description: You are not swallowed by thoughts and emotions; you step back and observe them.

themes.label: Awareness of awareness
themes.description: You notice the awareness itself that is seeing and feeling.

themes.label: Disidentification from thought
themes.description: You do not treat every thought that appears as absolute truth.

themes.label: Disidentification from emotion
themes.description: Even when anger or sadness is present, you do not believe that you are anger or sadness itself.

themes.label: Freedom from roles
themes.description: You know that roles such as parent, profession, or title are not the whole of who you are.

themes.label: Awareness beneath personality
themes.description: You sense a quiet self beneath your personality and the story of your past.

themes.label: Pure awareness
themes.description: You simply notice, without immediately judging.

themes.label: Self-inquiry
themes.description: You look within to discover what your true self is.

themes.label: Awakening to the true self
themes.description: You realize that temporary emotions and personality are not the whole of your true self.

themes.label: Unity of being and awareness
themes.description: Rather than only feeling that you have awareness, you sense that you are awareness itself.

themes.label: Equanimity
themes.description: You are not completely controlled by pleasant or unpleasant experiences.

themes.label: Non-reactivity
themes.description: When something happens, you can pause instead of reacting immediately from emotion.

themes.label: Non-attachment
themes.description: You can care deeply without trying to possess or control a person or thing.

themes.label: Non-attachment to views
themes.description: You do not assume that only your own viewpoint is correct.

themes.label: Equal regard for success and failure
themes.description: You know that your worth does not change whether you succeed or fail.

themes.label: Freedom from praise and criticism
themes.description: Whether praised or criticized, you do not completely lose yourself.

themes.label: Freedom from gain and loss
themes.description: Gaining or losing something does not destroy your inner foundation.

themes.label: Observing desire
themes.description: You notice wanting without being ruled by it.

themes.label: Holding fear
themes.description: Fear may be present, but it is not the only thing deciding your actions.

themes.label: Open-hearted stability
themes.description: Even when there is a possibility of being hurt, you do not close your heart completely.

themes.label: Loving-kindness
themes.description: You sincerely wish for your own happiness and the happiness of others.

themes.label: Compassion
themes.description: You notice another person’s suffering and want to do what you can.

themes.label: Unconditional love
themes.description: Even when someone does not meet your expectations, you continue to value their existence.

themes.label: Self-compassion
themes.description: You offer kind words and a gentle attitude to yourself when you are suffering.

themes.label: Forgiveness
themes.description: You do not declare the other person’s action right; you release the anger that keeps hurting you.

themes.label: Love born from understanding
themes.description: You see not only a person’s outward behavior, but also the pain beneath it.

themes.label: Empathy
themes.description: You try to imagine and feel what another person may be experiencing.

themes.label: Sharing joy
themes.description: You can celebrate another person’s happiness or success without envy.

themes.label: Love without discrimination
themes.description: Regardless of preference, you recognize the value of every life.

themes.label: Inclusiveness
themes.description: You can receive people and ideas that differ from you without immediately rejecting them.

themes.label: Gentleness
themes.description: You use your strength to help rather than control.

themes.label: Deep listening
themes.description: You listen fully without rushing to argue or give advice.

themes.label: Loving speech
themes.description: You choose not only what is correct, but also a way of speaking that does not wound.

themes.label: Interbeing
themes.description: You understand that you cannot exist without the support of other people and nature.

themes.label: Connection with life
themes.description: You feel connected not only with people, but also with animals, plants, and the earth.

themes.label: A sense of oneness
themes.description: You feel that you and the world are not completely separate.

themes.label: Freedom from separation
themes.description: The feeling that you are isolated and cut off from the world begins to soften.

themes.label: Universal self-awareness
themes.description: You sense in others the same life and awareness that are present in you.

themes.label: Nondual awareness
themes.description: You feel that self and world are not fundamentally separate.

themes.label: Awareness that all is one
themes.description: You sense that many forms of existence arise from the same source.

themes.label: Oneness that includes difference
themes.description: You understand that people can be different and still be deeply connected.

themes.label: Cosmic consciousness
themes.description: You experience yourself not only as one person, but as part of the whole universe.

themes.label: Unity with the divine
themes.description: You do not experience the divine only as distant; you also sense it within yourself.

themes.label: Union of lover and beloved
themes.description: In deep love, the distinction between giver and receiver begins to fade.

groups.label: Humility and openness to not knowing

themes.label: Humility
themes.description: You understand that you do not know everything.

themes.label: Beginner’s mind
themes.description: You do not assume you already know; you look with fresh eyes.

themes.label: Allowing not knowing
themes.description: Even without an answer, you do not force yourself to invent one.

themes.label: Teachability
themes.description: You can learn from anyone and from any experience.

themes.label: Freedom from self-justification
themes.description: You know that admitting a mistake does not erase your worth.

themes.label: Flexible understanding
themes.description: When you learn new facts, you can change your view.

themes.label: Openness to mystery
themes.description: You do not immediately reject what cannot be explained by reason.

themes.label: Awe
themes.description: In the presence of nature, the universe, or life’s vastness, you feel sincere reverence.

themes.label: Wonder
themes.description: Even ordinary events can feel fresh and mysterious.

themes.label: Self-honesty
themes.description: You do not hide your true feelings or motives from yourself.

themes.label: Courage to see the truth
themes.description: Even when reality is uncomfortable, you are willing to face it honestly.

themes.label: Discernment
themes.description: You can distinguish fear, desire, assumption, and intuition.

themes.label: Insight
themes.description: You see not only what is happening on the surface, but also the causes beneath it.

themes.label: Clarity
themes.description: Even in confusion, you do not lose sight of what matters.

themes.label: Right seeing
themes.description: You reduce the influence of assumptions and try to see reality as accurately as possible.

themes.label: Freedom from prejudice
themes.description: You do not judge people or situations only through upbringing or preconceptions.

themes.label: Awakening from illusion
themes.description: You can distinguish the story you created from what is actually happening.

themes.label: Inner alignment
themes.description: What you think, feel, say, and do are not deeply divided.

themes.label: Choosing what is essential
themes.description: You give your time and energy to what truly matters.

themes.label: Unconditional joy
themes.description: You can feel joy in being alive even without a special achievement.

themes.label: Contentment
themes.description: You can feel that what is present now is enough.

themes.label: Gratitude
themes.description: You notice what you have already received and value it.

themes.label: Feeling blessed
themes.description: You receive small events in daily life as gifts worthy of gratitude.

themes.label: Inner abundance
themes.description: Fulfillment comes from within, not only from the amount of money or possessions you have.

themes.label: Bliss
themes.description: You feel deep happiness even without a clear reason.

themes.label: Lightness
themes.description: You do not treat yourself or life with unnecessary heaviness.

themes.label: Playfulness
themes.description: You live life not only as a problem to solve, but as a place to enjoy, experiment, and create.

themes.label: Natural delight
themes.description: Life energy that had been held back can flow freely.

themes.label: The sense of being enough
themes.description: You feel that, at the deepest level, you already have what is needed to exist.

themes.label: Sensitivity to the sacred
themes.description: You can sense deep meaning and dignity within ordinary daily life.

themes.label: Awareness of divine presence
themes.description: Wherever you are, you feel accompanied by a sacred presence.

themes.label: Prayerful awareness
themes.description: You do not only state a wish; you turn your whole heart toward the sacred.

themes.label: Remembrance
themes.description: Even in a busy life, you do not forget your essence or the sacred.

themes.label: Devotion
themes.description: You use your life and abilities not only for yourself, but for a greater purpose.

themes.label: Taking refuge
themes.description: You value truth and sacred teaching more than personal desire or convenience.

themes.label: Reverence
themes.description: You honor the sacred as something you cannot control or fully understand.

themes.label: Sacred intimacy
themes.description: The sacred does not feel far away; it feels close within your heart.

themes.label: Listening for guidance
themes.description: You listen not only to mental plans, but also to the quiet sense within.

themes.label: Receiving grace
themes.description: You do not try to obtain everything through effort alone; you also receive help and blessing.

themes.label: Inner freedom
themes.description: Even when outer conditions are limited, you can still choose your attitude and actions.

themes.label: Freedom from conditioning
themes.description: You do not treat ideas inherited from family, society, or the past as absolute truth.

themes.label: Freedom from ego
themes.description: You are not consumed by protecting yourself or proving that you are right.

themes.label: Freedom from fear
themes.description: Fear may exist, but you do not let it rule your life.

themes.label: Freedom from desire
themes.description: You do not believe you can be happy only after getting what you want.

themes.label: Freedom from identification with suffering
themes.description: Even when suffering is present, you do not believe that you are suffering itself.

themes.label: Freedom from the past
themes.description: You do not let past events define the limits of who you are now.

themes.label: Freedom from compulsive control of the future
themes.description: You no longer believe the future must be perfectly prepared before you can feel safe.

themes.label: Awareness beyond life and death
themes.description: You sense that life is more than the body between birth and death.

themes.label: Liberation and awakening
themes.description: You are no longer ruled by attachment, assumption, and separation.

themes.label: Service
themes.description: You use your abilities not only for yourself, but also for others and society.

themes.label: Generosity
themes.description: You share not only money, but also time, knowledge, and kindness.

themes.label: Responsible freedom
themes.description: You do not harm others in the name of your own freedom.

themes.label: Ethical alignment
themes.description: You express in action what you inwardly believe is important.

themes.label: Courage
themes.description: Even when afraid, you choose what you truly value.

themes.label: Patience
themes.description: You do not force your own growth or another person’s growth to happen faster.

themes.label: Resilience
themes.description: Even in difficulty, you do not completely lose hope or tenderness.

themes.label: Love with boundaries
themes.description: You do not confuse love with enduring everything.

themes.label: Harmony
themes.description: You value ways for yourself, others, and nature to live together without unnecessary strain.

themes.label: Creative response
themes.description: Rather than repeating habitual reactions, you choose a new response suited to the moment.

themes.label: Authenticity
themes.description: You live as your real self rather than as a version designed to please others.

themes.label: Alignment with purpose
themes.description: You give your life to the direction you genuinely feel matters.

themes.label: Ordinariness
themes.description: You do not need to become special; you live everyday life with care.

themes.label: Emptiness
themes.description: You understand that nothing exists as an isolated, fixed thing; everything arises through relationships.

themes.label: No-self
themes.description: You realize there is no permanent, unchanging self.

themes.label: Pure being
themes.description: Beyond name, role, and personality, there is the simple sense of being.

themes.label: Pure consciousness
themes.description: The awareness that remains even when thoughts and emotions are absent.

themes.label: Nonduality
themes.description: You feel that self and world, observer and observed, are not fundamentally separate.

themes.label: Absolute oneness
themes.description: You directly sense that all existence appears from one source.

themes.label: Self-realization
themes.description: You know that your essence goes beyond personality and the story of your past.

themes.label: Union with the divine
themes.description: You feel the boundary between yourself and the sacred dissolve.

themes.label: Dissolution of ego
themes.description: The ego does not necessarily disappear, but it no longer rules your life.

themes.label: Dissolving into love
themes.description: The walls built to protect yourself soften within deep love.

themes.label: The eternal now
themes.description: You sense that only the present exists eternally, rather than past or future.

themes.label: Awareness beyond words
themes.description: A state that cannot be fully explained through words or thought and must be directly experienced.

themes.label: High vibration
themes.description: A state of strongly feeling love, joy, gratitude, and ease.

themes.label: Balanced energy
themes.description: Mind, body, and thought no longer strongly conflict and feel integrated.

themes.label: An open heart
themes.description: You are not afraid to give love or receive it.

themes.label: Alignment with the soul
themes.description: You live according to your deepest truth rather than the expectations around you.

themes.label: Alignment with the higher self
themes.description: You act not from fear or craving, but from a wider and wiser perspective within yourself.

themes.label: Your natural frequency
themes.description: You stop forcing yourself to become someone else and express your original nature.

themes.label: Harmony with the universe
themes.description: You feel that your actions are aligned with the larger movement of life.

themes.label: Receiving synchronicity
themes.description: You can sense meaning or guidance in meaningful coincidences.

themes.label: Abundance consciousness
themes.description: You do not assume you have nothing; you notice the blessings already present.

themes.label: Living from fulfillment rather than lack
themes.description: You act not because you are deficient, but from an inner sense of already being nourished.

themes.label: Allowing yourself to receive
themes.description: You can receive love, help, money, and appreciation without guilt.

themes.label: Alignment with manifestation
themes.description: Your wishes, thoughts, emotions, and actions point in the same direction.

themes.label: Living the soul’s purpose
themes.description: You live what you truly wish to experience and express in this lifetime.

themes.label: Openness to intuition
themes.description: You trust not only reason, but also the natural sense that arises from within.

themes.label: Energetic lightness
themes.description: You are no longer strongly bound by past emotions or heavy beliefs.

themes.label: Unconditional self-worth
themes.description: Even without success or approval, you feel that you have value.

themes.label: Essential self-expression
themes.description: You do not over-adapt to others; you express your real feelings and gifts.

themes.label: Creator consciousness
themes.description: You do not see yourself only as a victim of life; you recognize your power to shape life through choice.

themes.label: Co-creative consciousness
themes.description: You understand that life is shaped not by you alone, but together with others and a larger flow.

themes.label: Earth consciousness / Gaia consciousness
themes.description: You do not treat Earth merely as a resource; you value it as a living whole that supports all beings.
